Overview

Lecce is a city in Apulia with a population of 95,000. The Florence of the South, renowned for its stunning Baroque architecture, ornate churches, and warm Salento hospitality. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 250 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews older, with a median age of 47.0.
